sen1_event_descriptors.season_rule: include only if acquisition date is verified from source metadata; never infer from event name
sen1_event_descriptors.primary_risk: mean event risk across six replicated U-Net/TerraMind model-modality cells and three seeds
sen1_event_descriptors.inference: descriptive Spearman plus leave-one-event-out range; no causal claim

reben_shift_error_structure.comparison: paired S2 ID versus unchanged-head S1 shift
reben_shift_error_structure.prohibited_interpretation: exclusive multiclass substitution or causal SAR mechanism

alphaearth_boundary_distance.distance: 10 m class-edge distance, right-censored at 512 pixels
alphaearth_boundary_distance.primary_association: partial Spearman of disagreement risk versus log1p boundary distance controlling country and reference class
alphaearth_boundary_distance.prohibited_interpretation: independent ground truth or causal model failure

sen1_decision_scenario.comparison: U-Net S1+S2 mean-selected versus U-Net S2 tail-selected

cluster_mtd_intervals.unsupported_result: insufficient_independent_clusters or partial identification; never forced CI
